name: CommandEffect
description: Represents a command effect for an animation behavior. You can send events, call functions, and send OLE verbs to embedded objects using this object.
remarks: Use the CommandEffect property of the AnimationBehavior object to return a CommandEffect object. Command effects can be changed using the CommandEffect object's Command and Type properties.
example:
Set bhvEffect = effectNew.Behaviors.Add(msoAnimTypeCommand)



    With bhvEffect.CommandEffect

         .Type = msoAnimCommandTypeVerb

         .Command = Play

    End With

properties.name: Application

properties.name: Type
properties.description: Represents the type of animation. Read/write.

properties.name: Command
properties.description: Represents the command to be executed for the command effect. Read/write.

properties.description: Sets or returns the bookmark of the specified object. Read/write.
